scope: Six user-supplied photos, not a labeled accuracy benchmark. Two deployed models; direct YOLO vs registry vs isolated FastAPI endpoint at confidence 0.25. Additional confidence 0.05 diagnostic. No browser automation or production database writes.

visual_observations.1: Clear physical separation/fracture of assembled/soldered board.
visual_observations.2: Low-resolution angled assembled board; specific defect not confidently established visually.
visual_observations.3: Visible surface/coating irregularity; exact failure type not established.
visual_observations.4: Soldering/repair in progress; cannot establish electrical defect from photo alone.
visual_observations.5: Severe visible surface damage; exact material/electrical failure not established.

limitations: Physical fracture, burns, delamination, corrosion and solder quality are not explicit trained labels.
No-detection does not establish board health.
More detections at lower confidence do not demonstrate correct damage recognition.
Current frontend already warns no detections does not certify defect-free; no automatic unsupported-image gate exists.
